title: Slow Cooker Mexican Pork Carnitas - Vicky Pham
ldKeywords: pork carnitas, slow cooker carnitas, Mexican pulled pork, easy carnitas recipe, taco filling, crispy pork tacos, slow cooker Mexican recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 3 lbs pork shoulder/butt (trim off excess fat)
ldInstructionsRaw: Season the pork shoulder with oregano, cumin, black pepper, salt, chili powder, and cinnamon.
Add pork to a slow cooker. Add water, onion, garlic and bay leaf.
Remove from cooker and chop into small pieces against the grain.
Brown the pork in a large skillet with a bit of oil from the slow cooker. Serve with flour or corn tortillas, salsa and pickled jalapenos.
